Strategy: Layer the parity-band bonus onto the window shaping: best-fit base, +25 for residuals 30-45, -25 for residuals 10-20, plus +10 when the residual's tens digit is even. The ranking changes when two bins sit in the same window but different parity bands. It may help by breaking ties toward residuals that pair with common item sizes, but may fail if the parity pattern is noise.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if 30 <= r - item <= 45 else 0) - (25 if 10 <= r - item <= 20 else 0) + (10 if ((r - item) // 10) % 2 == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```

The ranking changes when the tight-bin count crosses three. It may help by saving scarce near-exact fits, but may fail if worst-fit drift opens new bins.
